name: Write/Read Same Page
details: localStorage.setItem and getItem functional with exact string values

name: Key Overwrite Behavior
details: Writing existing key updates value in-place without duplicate entries

name: Origin Isolation
details: Storage partitions separate records by normalized scheme/host/port

name: removeItem Semantics
details: localStorage.removeItem purges target key; subsequent getItem returns empty/null

name: clear() Origin Scoping
details: localStorage.clear() drops only matching origin keys; other origins preserved

name: key(index) & length Properties
details: storage_key and storage_length accurately reflect active items

name: Persistence Across Reboot
details: Serialized storage records saved to /firstos_browser.dat via VFS and restored on boot

name: SessionStorage Reset on Reboot
details: sessionStorage remains in RAM (g_session_storage) and resets cleanly on reboot

name: Corruption-Safe Recovery
details: CRC-32 checksum validated per record; corrupted records discarded safely

name: Storage Size Limit Enforcement
details: Defensive cap on record bytes (192 val, 48 key, 96 origin) prevents buffer overruns
